subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: What stable process-event contract should OpenClaw expose for session/run progress, including event taxonomy, replay/persistence, authorization, and redaction?
rationale: Current code has generic agent/item/tool/lifecycle streams but no durable session-level process/step source of truth; implementing this request defines public Gateway/session semantics and security boundaries.

options.title: Approve a Gateway process contract
options.body: Add an additive Gateway-owned process/step event contract with stable ids, bounded replay, redacted payloads, documented permissions, and mappings from existing streams.

options.title: Fold into session activity design
options.body: Defer this issue behind the broader per-session activity API work and keep this issue focused on process taxonomy requirements.

options.title: Keep consumer-only progress
options.body: Use existing generic streams for UI and CLI progress without promising a stable replayable process contract yet.

recommendation.title: Approve a Gateway process contract
recommendation.body: Add an additive Gateway-owned process/step event contract with stable ids, bounded replay, redacted payloads, documented permissions, and mappings from existing streams.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest feature history is the structured execution item event work in src/infra/agent-events.ts.
